{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Cross-tabulate 'converted' and 'status' to see if they agree
ct = pd.crosstab(df['converted'], df['status'])

# Check if any row has 'converted' = 1 but 'status' = 'refunded'
error_rows = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]

# Print cross-tab and error rows
ct, error_rows"}
